comments.text: A mysterious character. We know so little and what we know is so strange: she lives in a dream world and dresses as a maid, but her species is a demon while the theme calls her an "Illusion of a Maid." She's not there to serve anyone because she's a co-ruler of the realm! The lack of information only makes her character more fun to consider and to me personally she feels like mischief incarnate, an illogical and contradictory existence that continues purely for the fun of living.
